dedupe_keys.name: library of industrial symbiosis case studies and linked exchanges maestri

description: This University of Cambridge dataset is a library of documented industrial symbiosis cases, in which one plant's waste, by-product, energy or water becomes another's input, together with a database of the individual exchanges. It was built by the Centre for Industrial Sustainability in the Horizon 2020 project MAESTRI on energy and resource management in the process industries. Cases were gathered from public sources such as papers, presentations and white papers, all referenced. Each case has a narrative followed by sections on triggering factors, preconditions and barriers, and each exchange is identified by a combination of case, source and sequence numbers that links the two sections. The dataset is one Excel workbook of about 218 KB, published on 16 October 2017 in the Apollo repository and free under CC BY-SA 4.0. Authors are Stephen Evans, Miriam Benedetti and Maria Holgado Granados. Caveats: it covers published cases only, quantities are given only where the sources state them, and it is a 2017 snapshot. For simulation it gives real material and energy links between plants, which can seed interdependency networks of industrial parks and show which firms lose inputs when a partner plant stops. Related catalogue records include the SYMBA database of industrial symbiosis solutions and the international dataset on eco-innovation parks.
